The plate is about 360 px across, so I'm assuming a dinner plate of roughly 26 cm. That gives about 14 px per cm. The food patch is about 160 px wide and 450-160 = 290 px... more precisely, about 160 px wide by 140 px tall, which is roughly 11 cm by 10 cm.

The food looks like roasted sweet potato or pumpkin pieces with some red cabbage. It is probably 1-2 cm thick, so I estimate about 100 cm² of footprint. At roughly 1.5 cm thick that is about 150 cm³, and with air gaps the mass comes to about 130 g.

Sweet potato with some oil runs about 1.3 kcal/g, which gives roughly 170 kcal.
